mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cage_sync_lock (scope_type, scope_key, locked, reason, operator_id, operator_name) VALUES (#{scopeType}, #{scopeKey}, #{locked}, #{reason}, #{operatorId}, #{operatorName})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cage_sync_lock WHERE scope_type = #{scopeType} AND scope_key = #{scopeKey}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM cage_sync_lock ORDER BY scope_type ASC, scope_key ASC
